pairs.why: A's chunky, saturated teal saucer matches the soft toy-like chunkiness and color of the real cards, while B's silver body looks more like metal and closer to a statue.
A has the chunky, rounded, soft-edged build and stubby feet of the real locker, while B is thinner and harder-edged, like a realistic metal locker on legs.
A has the real pump's chunky build, cream inset panel with counter and gauge, and holstered nozzle, while B is a plainer, smoother cylinder with less of the real card's built detail.
The two are nearly identical, but B's rim has a stronger glossy highlight, and A's softer rim sits slightly closer to the real clock's satin finish.
B's large, smooth, soft gloves fill the frame like the real card, while A's gloves are smaller and more creased and glossy.
B's glowing swirl and curled gold stand read as a stylized game asset like the real cards, while A is a plain glass ball with a flat, statue-like gloss on a generic base.
A is a close, chunky light with a thick yoke and a big three-lens face like the real card, while B is small and distant with thin parts.
B copies the real chair's stool-with-back layout but has thin, oddly joined tubes, while A has the real card's thick tubes, soft rendering and coherent build even though it is an armchair.
